epics.name: Workday Integration & User Experience Enhancement
epics.description: Integration of the inclusivity scoring tool within the Workday environment to streamline the job requisition process and provide real-time feedback to recruiters.
epics.in_scope: Workday Extend development, UI integration for real-time recommendations, screen streamlining, and optional scoring toggles.
epics.out_of_scope: Modifications to Workday's core delivered model beyond the requisition screen.
Scoring for non-job description text (e.g., candidate resumes).
epics.name: Core Inclusivity Scoring Engine
epics.description: Development and refinement of the ML-driven scoring engine, including support for configurable parameters and manual overrides.
epics.in_scope: ML model implementation for 22 signals, REST API development, configurable scoring logic, and manager override capabilities.
NLP support for French, German, Italian, and Portuguese; localization of scoring signals.
epics.name: Global Language & Localization Support
epics.description: Expansion of the tool's capabilities to support multiple languages and regions beyond the initial English-only scope.

epics.name: Platform Performance, Audit & Governance
epics.description: Ensuring system reliability, data integrity, and alignment with technical standards through audit logging and performance scaling.
epics.in_scope: AWS scaling configuration, PII-compliant audit logging, and technical design documentation.

stories.tasks: Configure Workday Extend environment, Map Workday requisition fields to scoring API inputs
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a developer has access to Workday, When building the integration, Then Workday Extend must be used as the primary development platform.
stories.user_story: As a developer, I want to use Workday Extend so that the solution is built on the approved corporate platform.
stories.title: Develop Integration using Workday Extend
stories.description: Utilize Workday Extend to build the integration layer that connects Workday Recruiting with the AWS-based scoring engine.

stories.tasks: Integrate GenAI recommendation endpoint into Workday UI, Implement real-time trigger for scoring on text change
stories.title: Real-time GenAI Recommendations in Workday UI
stories.user_story: As a recruiter, I want to see real-time inclusivity suggestions so that I can improve the job posting immediately without leaving Workday.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a recruiter is creating a job requisition in Workday, When they enter text, Then GenAI recommendations and inclusivity scores must appear in real-time on the same screen.
stories.description: Implement real-time feedback loops within the Workday UI using GenAI to provide suggestions as the job description is being written.

stories.tasks: Identify and remove unused requisition fields, Implement auto-population logic for standard fields
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the job requisition creation screen, When a user views the page, Then unused fields must be hidden and standard data must be auto-populated.
stories.user_story: As a recruiter, I want a streamlined requisition screen so that I can create job postings faster with less manual effort.
stories.title: Streamline Job Requisition Screen
stories.description: Optimize the Workday job requisition interface by removing unnecessary fields and automating data entry where possible.

stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the pilot phase of the tool, When a manager creates a requisition, Then they must have the option to bypass the inclusivity scoring.
stories.tasks: Add optional scoring toggle to Workday UI, Update workflow logic to handle skipped scoring cycles
stories.title: Optional Scoring for Pilot Phase
stories.description: Introduce a configuration or toggle that allows users to opt-out of the scoring process during the initial pilot phase.
stories.user_story: As a manager, I want the ability to opt-out of scoring during the pilot so that I can maintain flexibility during the rollout.

stories.tasks: Conduct requirement workshops for regional scoring logic, Document scoring parameter matrix by job type and country
stories.user_story: As a product owner, I want to define the flexible scoring logic so that the engine provides accurate results across different regions.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the requirement for flexible scoring, When defining the system logic, Then the specific parameters for job types and regions must be documented and approved.
stories.title: Define Flexible Scoring Parameters
stories.description: Collaborate with stakeholders to define the specific scoring logic and parameters for different job types and countries, as these are currently undefined.

stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a calculated inclusivity score, When a manager reviews the results, Then they must be able to override the suggestions and provide a custom score based on local context.
stories.user_story: As a manager, I want to override automated suggestions so that I can account for specific local hiring requirements.
stories.tasks: Create override UI component in Workday, Implement logic to capture and store manual score adjustments
stories.description: Provide a mechanism for managers to manually adjust or override automated inclusivity scores when local requirements differ from the ML model's output.
stories.title: Manager Override and Custom Scoring

stories.user_story: As a recruiter, I want to recalculate scores for existing requisitions so that I can verify improvements made to older postings.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given an existing or new job requisition, When the text is edited, Then the system must allow for a score recalculation.
stories.description: Enable the ability to trigger a new scoring cycle for both newly created and existing job requisitions after updates are made to the text.
stories.tasks: Enable recalculation trigger for existing requisitions, Update API to handle re-scoring requests for saved requisitions
stories.title: Score Recalculation for New and Existing Requisitions

stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a request to the Scoring API, When the ML model processes the text, Then it must evaluate 22 specific signals across four categories: Clarity, Inclusive Culture, Exclusive Practices, and Language.
stories.tasks: Implement 22-signal ML analysis logic, Secure API with Token-based authentication and HTTPS
stories.user_story: As a system, I want to analyze job descriptions against 22 signals so that I can provide a comprehensive inclusivity score.
stories.description: Implement the core ML scoring logic using 22 signals to generate a composite inclusivity score via a secure AWS REST API.
stories.title: ML-Based Inclusivity Scoring Engine Implementation
Multi-Language Support for Job Postings
stories.description: Expand the scoring engine to support multiple European languages, moving beyond the initial English-only constraint.
stories.tasks: Develop NLP models for French, German, Italian, and Portuguese, Validate scoring signals for linguistic nuances in each language
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a job description in French, German, Italian, or Portuguese, When submitted for scoring, Then the system must accurately evaluate the text based on localized inclusivity signals.
stories.user_story: As a global recruiter, I want to score job descriptions in multiple languages so that I can ensure inclusivity across all regions.

stories.description: Configure the AWS infrastructure to automatically scale to handle up to 5,000 monthly requisitions and peak activity periods.
stories.tasks: Configure AWS Auto-scaling groups, Conduct load testing for 5,000 monthly requisitions volume
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a peak hiring month like August, When volume reaches 5,000 requisitions, Then the system must maintain <3s performance and ≥99.9% availability.
stories.title: Automated Scaling for High Volume Performance
stories.user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to scale automatically so that performance remains stable during peak hiring seasons.

stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a completed scoring cycle, When the data is persisted, Then it must include scores and recommendations but exclude all candidate PII.
stories.tasks: Design PII-free database schema for scoring results, Implement audit logging for recommendation acceptance status
stories.description: Implement a secure data persistence layer to store scoring history and audit logs while strictly adhering to PII-free business rules.
stories.title: Secure Scoring Persistence and Audit Logging
stories.user_story: As an auditor, I want to see historical scoring changes without exposing PII so that I can analyze trends safely.
As a technical lead, I want to review the design and backlog so that the team avoids redundant work and stays aligned on priorities.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the start of the implementation phase, When reviewing the project scope, Then a technical design document and updated backlog must be finalized.
stories.description: Produce the necessary technical design documentation and conduct a backlog review to ensure all priorities are aligned and redundant work is avoided.
stories.tasks: Draft technical design document, Conduct backlog alignment session with stakeholders
stories.title: Technical Design and Backlog Alignment

reasoning_log.reasoning: No existing backlog item addresses the integration of an inclusivity scoring tool or the use of Workday Extend for real-time recruiter feedback.
The existing backlog contains candidate screening AI (DEF-36) but lacks any mention of a machine learning engine specifically for job description inclusivity analysis.
The backlog identifies issues with wrong languages and missing legal text; this epic adds a functional layer of linguistic analysis for those regions.
reasoning_log.impact: Extends existing language and legal text requirements by introducing automated NLP scoring support for specific European languages (French, German, Italian, Portuguese).
Adds high-scale AWS performance requirements and PII-compliant audit logic to existing basic audit and logging concepts.
reasoning_log.reasoning: The backlog includes basic auditing and logging bugs; this epic refines those into a comprehensive governance and performance framework.
The use of Workday Extend as a development platform for external API integration is not covered in the current backlog.
Real-time GenAI feedback within the Workday UI is a new capability not mentioned in existing JD-related bugs.
Existing bugs report general issues with creating or viewing requisitions; this story provides a specific UI optimization to resolve those friction points.
reasoning_log.impact: Addresses requisition creation difficulties by introducing field hiding and auto-population logic to simplify the UI.

reasoning_log.reasoning: The concept of a pilot-phase toggle for scoring is specific to this new feature and has no precedent in the backlog.
Defining regional scoring parameters is a new requirement for the inclusivity engine.
Manual override of automated scoring is a new functional requirement not present in existing items.

reasoning_log.impact: Introduces a specific recalculation trigger for the scoring engine when JD edits are made, addressing the gap where changes are not reflected.
reasoning_log.reasoning: The backlog notes that JD changes are sometimes not visible or refreshed; this story adds a functional trigger to ensure scoring stays in sync with edits.
The implementation of a 22-signal ML model for inclusivity is distinct from any existing candidate screening or job posting tasks.
The backlog identifies confusing or incorrect language; this story provides the technical solution to analyze and score those languages.
reasoning_log.impact: Adds automated linguistic evaluation for inclusivity to existing requirements for correct language and terminology.

reasoning_log.reasoning: Infrastructure scaling for high-volume requisition processing is not addressed in the current bug list.
The backlog identifies missing audit trails for JD changes; this story extends that to include the new scoring data while ensuring data privacy.
reasoning_log.impact: Refines existing audit requirements by adding PII-free persistence rules and specific scoring history tracking.

reasoning_log.reasoning: Technical design documentation and backlog alignment are project-level tasks not represented in the existing issue list.
